text:
erin: Heads up - hit a bundler interop bug while doing a prod rollup build for the edge sampleapp. Dev server (vite) works, prod dist fails at runtime with `TypeError: t.default is not a function`
sam: Paste the runtime stack?
erin: Here it is: `TypeError: t.default is not a function
 at sendRequest (dist/index.js:123:45)`
kevin: Sounds like default export shape changed. Which import are you using?
erin: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` (TS project, esModuleInterop=false). Works locally, fails in edge bundle (rollup -> cjs output).
maria: Vite prebundles deps with esbuild which can add .default wrappers. Rollup then bundles source into cjs, adding interop helpers. Different toolchains => different module shapes.
erin: I tried `import * as Redwood from` and `const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference-sdk')` - each variant works in some envs and breaks in others. Not consistent.
sam: Can you share minimal repro (package.json + rollup config)?
erin: Minimal below: `{"name":"edge-sample","type":"module","dependencies":{"@redwood/inference-sdk":"workspace:packages/sdk"}}` and `// rollup.config.js export default { input: 'src/index.js', output: { file: 'dist/index.js', format: 'cjs' }, plugins: [] }`
kevin: output.format=cjs + type=module in package.json can produce wrapped exports. Also terser/minify can mangle helper names.
maria: Typescript config matters too; esModuleInterop false may silence typings errors while runtime differs. Also our SDK d.ts uses `export = Redwood` which encourages CJS import style while runtime is ESM. That mismatch causes DX confusion.
sam: Short-term fix in app: dynamic import check: `const S = await import('@redwood/inference-sdk'); const Client = S.default ?? S;` Ugly but works across bundlers.
kevin: Long term SDK fixes: add both cjs and esm builds, set package.json exports map (`{"import":"dist/index.esm.js","require":"dist/index.cjs.js"}`), and adjust .d.ts to declare `export default` plus named exports so TS consumers don't need esModuleInterop.
maria: Also we should add docs: recommended bundler settings (rollup: output.exports='auto' or format:'esm' if runtime supports it; vite: avoid legacy plugin for edge builds). Provide sample configs.
erin: I'll open DEVEX-4123 with repro branch: github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/tree/devex/esinterop-repro and attach a minimal SDK stub + rollup configs. devex-bot: Branch created by erin: devex/esinterop-repro (CI queued). build-bot: Prod build failed (same error).
sam: Repro checklist for SDK team: steps, minimal lib that exports default, sampleapp import variants, bundler configs+versions, tsconfig, dist artifacts, runtime logs.
kevin: Also note terser mangle options can break helpers. Keep helper names or disable certain mangling.
maria: I'll draft a DX doc with examples for rollup/vite/webpack + TS settings and add to docs repo.
erin: Filed the ticket and pinged @kevin @maria. Thanks! :thumbsup:
